exact_result: Dense-null-leaf curve-free transcendental rank-one torus: smooth ordinary P-type zero, numerical/actual/Cao current degree one, but every usual unrescaled analytic-current body on every fixed smooth Kähler model and smooth complete flag tends to a point. Positive smooth perturbation paths have the same limit; perturbative area has explicitly reference-sensitive leading coefficient. Retains the supplied divisorial/product theorem and dense-pole recipe obstruction.
concrete_gaps: No general geometric/valuation construction for arbitrary prescribed ordinary P-envelope types.
No general numerical dimension or actual/Cao product theorem for a new lower-dimensional carrier.
No general carrier/scale/flag/modification independence result for any construction evading the explicit usual-valuation and unrescaled-limit axioms.
No impossibility theorem for all richer geometric constructions satisfying the unchanged original task.
